title: Tibia, Diablo and Hades just had a child - Rogue Chronicles
author: Bhr3X
selftext:
Friends, been working on this project for a couple of months and finally decided I'm ready to share. 

It's a roguelite dungeon crawler that takes the best of three of my favorite games.  
\- Skill xp mechanic world graphic resembling of Tibia (at least for now)  
\- Chest / Item tiering resembling of Diablo  
\- Builds, Waves and doors resembling of Hades

It would mean the world if you guys could share feedbacks, ideas and bugs as I'm frequently patching it with new content and working to improve the experience overall.

Hope you enjoy.

[https://bhr3x.itch.io/rogue-chronicles](https://bhr3x.itch.io/rogue-chronicles)

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: It has good onboarding, what it work on a bit is pacing. The controls feels "jumpy" and "fast", not stratetic, paced and deliberate.

replies.author: Bhr3X
replies.body: Thanks friend! Well heard and makes a ton of sense!

replies.author: Bhr3X
replies.body:
u/bingewavecinema 

Just shipped v8.83.0 "The Held Note": every action now pays its cost inside its own window, and held movement runs on one fixed 70ms beat. It should read as more paced and deliberate now instead of jumpy.

Thank you so much for the feedback!
